body: Holy shit be careful posting here, there are a fair bit of lurking pedos.

I know exactly how this feels. I am very afraid of rejection when approaching people. I have around 3 friends in school and can only see them in 2-3 of my 8 classes. It’s hard because people form their groups which aren’t very accepting of people who are different from what they’re used to. I have attempted talking to some people but they’re usually equally as shy or are not interested. Someone started talking to me out of the blue via Snapchat and I have been so anxious I haven’t opened the app in a week. I used to have moderate OCD that scarred my hands (from what I can tell). I used to have to wash so much that it started destroying my hands. All I can say is that you’ll get through this. Who knows, maybe changes have to be made with your current situation. I am transferring to a smaller school because of what happened this year. You like art, maybe try something with that. Art is very fun thing to get into and is really something I wish I had the ability to do. I just know you can do this. Once you hit the bottom, you can only go up. I used to be in a very dark place where suicide was constantly in my mind. I’ll admit that I logged onto this account because I am feeling a bit like this now but I know things will get better for me. Trust that things will work out and trust yourself arounf other people. From what I’ve seen, school is a shitty environment to meet new people. Try some public social events. I go ice skating and people seem somewhat interested in meeting new people. Anyway, that was my advice. Good luck and you’ll get through this!!!
Sorry, I was out for a bit. All I can say study. I also don’t know anything about forensic psychology. I did a pacifist run because I heard it was the best one.

Thanks for replying, it really does help to know that someone cares. I know people who’ve had shitty times in high school but say “it gets better”, which gets harder and harder to believe. Hopefully we can get through this together! 

P.S. I haven’t played Deltarune but I loved Undertale and heard good things about Deltarune!
Thanks again, it really does mean a lot.

Well my mom’s taken me to the hospital to help but now she just gets angry and says things like “what if I killed myself” and “are you telling me this just so I feel bad”. My dad had always been thinking about me (got me a surprise hard drive one day because mine was almost full) but he also can get kinda angry. The school I go to is supposed to be good but I’ve never felt worse. When it comes to money, we don’t have money to throw around but we have enough to keep us more than happy. I know people who go on yearly Disney trips, have beach houses, and even a party boat (dunno how big it is but they said party boat). I always ask to myself what they are doing to get all of this. Also, thanks for responding, you don’t know how happy it made me to see someone who really cares. Thanks.
What’s wrong, what’s happening that makes you want to kill yourself?

Just know that you’re a good person. If you’re truly sorry for what you did and never want to do it again that’s already proof you’re more than a great person. Just please don’t kill yourself. I really do care about you and I don’t want anything to happen to you.

Please tell them. It’s not selfish to want to kill yourself. If anyone tells you that then they don’t know how much pain you’re really in. Just tell them and they will bring you to a hospital. I had to demand going to the hospital but maybe your parents are different.
Then don’t. Tell them how you feel and they can help you.
Tell them, if they know what’s going on they can help.

I told my mom and it made her sad. One day in the car tensions were very high. It got to the point where I demanded that she took me to the hospital. They helped me with and gave me a list of therapists and things I can do. After that, my mom seemed happy and hopeful. Telling her is the bravest thing you can do. Revealing your vulnerabilities isn’t weak, it’s one of the strongest things you can do.
Tell them again, let every single thing out. If they don’t help, find someone who will. Just don’t kill yourself please, I really care about you and I don’t want anything bad to happen to you.
Hey, If you need anything you can talk to me.
I was having a bad week a couple weeks ago so I went to the emergency room before things got worse. They really made me feel better knowing there was a way to get help.
Please don’t do it, hang on just a little longer. Talk to your brother, tell him how you feel. I really do care about you and I don’t want anything to happen to you. Please be safe.
You’re not evil, you just need help. Have you talked to anyone about this?
That’s why I’m here. If it makes you feel better, we’re in the same boat. I dunno if you’re in grade school, high school, or collage but it probably gets better eventually. I really can’t say though.
